ValidationRule.description: Created this Validation rule to mandate TCV field if contract term is above 12 in stage 4 and stage 5 #13028 #13027
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND ( NOT($Setup.Metadata_Activation_Settings__c.Disable_VR__c && OR(ISBLANK($Setup.Metadata_Activation_Settings__c.SObject_API_Name__c), CONTAINS($Setup.Metadata_Activation_Settings__c.SObject_API_Name__c, 'Opportunity'))),
Contract_Term_months__c>12,
OR( ISBLANK(Total_Contract_Value_TCV__c), Total_Contract_Value_TCV__c<1 ),
!IsVRByPassed__c,
OR( ISPICKVAL(StageName, '4 - Negotiate'), ISPICKVAL(StageName, '5 - Signed/PO in') ),
$Profile.Name <> 'IM_Sales_IMTN',
QTB_APIProcess__c = false,
NOT($Permission.VR_Bypass_Permission) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please enter a valid Total Contract Value(TCV) before moving to Stage 4 or Stage 5. Need help? Contact your Sales Operations Business Partner.
